articles.title: OpenSearchCon Europe 2026 Speaker Lineup Highlights the Future of Open Source Search, Observability and AI Innovation
articles.mainIdea: OpenSearchCon Europe 2026 Speaker Lineup Highlights the Future of Open Source Search, Observability and AI Innovation
articles.summary: PR Newswire: OpenSearchCon Europe 2026 Speaker Lineup Highlights the Future of Open Source Search, Observability and AI Innovation. The OpenSearch Software Foundation, the neutral home for the OpenSearch Project, today announced the schedule for OpenSearchCon Europe 2026, which takes place in Prague, Czechia from 16-17 April. The event will bring the global OpenSearch community together to shape the future of search, observability, analytics and agentic AI.

articles.summary: Business Wire: Clari + Salesloft Wins Gold Stevie® Award for Best Use of Technology in Sales for Unifying Revenue Intelligence and Execution. ATLANTA, February 19, 2026--Clari + Salesloft, the company behind the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, has won a Gold Stevie® Award in the Best Use of Technology in Sales category in the 20th annual Stevie Awards for Sales & Customer Service.
